report_target_store <- Sys.getenv("TRANSPLANT_TARGET_STORE", "_targets")
if (!grepl("^/", report_target_store)) {
  report_target_store <- file.path(here::here(), report_target_store)

report_target_store <- normalizePath(report_target_store, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)

## Trait predictors


### Question

Do LDMC, LMA, or vegetative height explain systematic response or residual species heterogeneity?

### Dataset and sample size

Each trait uses its own complete-case species/effect subset; the scaling table records all sample sizes.

### Exact model specification

For each trait, compare climate-only `M0`, additive-trait `M1`, and full `Trait_z * T_z * P_z * W_z` models on identical rows and covariance.

### Assumptions

Positive species medians are natural-log transformed and standardized over unique trait-complete species before row expansion. Missing traits are not imputed.

### Convergence and covariance diagnostics

Matched-row/V checks and branch-specific numerical regression gates accompany the ML and full REML results.

### Main numerical results

```{r}
scaling <- targets::tar_read(trait_scaling)
tables <- targets::tar_read(trait_model_tables)
knitr::kable(scaling)
knitr::kable(tables$fit_statistics)
knitr::kable(tables$comparisons)
knitr::kable(tables$CR1)
```

### Interpretation boundary

Each trait is fitted separately after log unique-species scaling; missing values are not imputed.

### Principal objects

`prepared_ldmc`, `prepared_lma`, `prepared_height`, and `trait_model_tables`.

### PASS/FAIL

Trait values, scaling, matched-row covariance checks, ML fits/comparisons, and
full-REML robust-inference rows must pass their current checks.
## Functional-group predictors


### Question

Do independently defined Graminoid status and Woodiness explain response structure?

### Dataset and sample size

Both predictors use the complete 1,604-effect, 526-species resident cohort; group coverage is shown below.

### Exact model specification

Each predictor is fitted separately as climate-only `M0`, additive-status `M1`, and full status-by-`T_z * P_z * W_z` interaction model.

### Assumptions

Graminoid and Woodiness assignments remain independent binary variables and
share the exact ordered `V_auc`. TNRS-derived family rows supply 525 retained
taxa; the shared resident-species override ledger augments the active functional
target with the validated non-graminoid/non-woody assignment for *Viola
palustris*.

### Convergence and covariance diagnostics

Branch-specific ML, CR1, assignment, source-coverage, and observed-support checks are shown below.

### Main numerical results

```{r}
tables <- targets::tar_read(functional_model_tables)
mask <- targets::tar_read(woodiness_support_mask_specification)
mask_audit <- targets::tar_read(woodiness_support_mask_audit)
coverage <- targets::tar_read(functional_climate_coverage)
source_audit <- targets::tar_read(functional_source_coverage_audit)
knitr::kable(tables$fit_statistics)
knitr::kable(tables$comparisons)
knitr::kable(tables$CR1)
knitr::kable(as.data.frame(mask[c("status", "needs_group_specific_observed_climate_support_mask", "model_refit_permitted")]))
knitr::kable(coverage)
knitr::kable(mask_audit)
knitr::kable(source_audit)
```

### Interpretation boundary

The Woodiness support mask is calculated independently within the observed climate support of each group. It is a plotting-only refinement and cannot change the fitted model.

### Principal objects

`functional_species`, `graminoid_model_sequence`,
`woodiness_model_sequence`, and `woodiness_support_mask`.

### PASS/FAIL

Assignments, source coverage, model tables, CR1 rows, and group-specific support construction must pass.
## Phylogenetic predictors


### Question

Does response-independent phylogenetic position (PEV1–PEV3) explain response structure?

### Dataset and sample size

The tree and PCoA contain exactly the 526 resident-cohort species; the PEV model uses all 1,604 effects and 42 experiments.

### Exact model specification

The tree is built with pinned V.PhyloMaker2 scenario 3. The PEV sequence compares climate-only `M0`, additive PEV `M1`, and the anchored PEV-by-climate `M3`.

### Assumptions

Placement decisions and axis signs are response-independent. Shared parent placements retain zero patristic distance.

### Convergence and covariance diagnostics

PCoA eigenstructure, package provenance, model comparisons, and CR1 are shown below.

### Main numerical results

```{r}
eigen <- targets::tar_read(pcoa_eigen_summary)
package <- targets::tar_read(phylogeny_package_source_provenance)
package_gate <- targets::tar_read(phylogeny_package_validation)
tables <- targets::tar_read(phylogeny_model_tables)
knitr::kable(eigen[seq_len(min(10, nrow(eigen))), ])
knitr::kable(package)
knitr::kable(package_gate)
knitr::kable(tables$fit_statistics)
knitr::kable(tables$comparisons)
knitr::kable(tables$CR1)
```

### Interpretation boundary

PEV1–PEV3 are selected and oriented without reference to Delta AUC. The active
model receives the independently built and oriented coordinates.

### Principal objects

`resident_phylogeny_rebuild`, `resident_pcoa_candidate`,
`resident_pev_scores_oriented`, `phylogeny_model_sequence`, and
`phylogeny_model_tables`.

### PASS/FAIL

All placement, distance, zero-distance, PEV, eigenstructure, model, and CR1 checks must pass.
